vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Hi, friends! Look at my big car parking lot!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Vroom, vroom! Here come the cars! Let's count them together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Count with your fingers, like Leo!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Beep, beep! Oops... that was my tummy!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Ha ha! Bobo, you are not a car!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh! Car number six wants to give Bobo a ride!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Wheee! Beep beep! Back you go, little car!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Nine! Uh oh... I need more paws!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Ten cars! And ten fingers! Show me your ten fingers!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now it's your turn to count them all! Ready? Point and count!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Wow fact! Some cars run on electricity. They are very, very quiet!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Shhh... quiet car! Not like my tummy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: A car rolls on wheels! How many wheels? Let's count!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: And cars say beep, beep! Can you say it too? Beep, beep!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Now let's play car games on the road!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Game time! Which road has more cars?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: This one! Five is more than three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, which road has fewer cars?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: This one! Two is less than four!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Two cars are on the road. One more drives in. How many now?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Three! Two and one make three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Three cars. Two more drive in. How many now?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Five! Three and two make five!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Five cars. Oh! Two drive away. How many are left?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Three! Five take away two is three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Color quiz! What color is car number one?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And what color is car number five?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And where is the number four?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's getting dark. The cars drive home to the garage to sleep. Let's count down!
